messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: It is possible to know how many resources does my app need before hire any paid subscription?
parts:
The disconnect at launch is more often an indication that the code has a problem that caused it to crash than that it has run out of resources.

Does the application run locally for you?

What do the shinyapps.io logs show? You can check them by running: rsconnect::showLogs() or by visiting the shinyapps.io dashboard and looking at the logs under your Application tab.

Once the application is running, the metrics tab in the dashboard should indicate how much CPU and memory your application is consuming.
